purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: D.V.D. Third-Country Removal Authority — 2025–2026
question: What decision right changed in D.V.D. between the March 2025 third-country-removal TRO and the September 2026 appellate and emergency-relief return?
bluf: The September 18 First Circuit opinion is a same-object legal maturation of the March 2025 D.V.D. dispute. It vacated two sequencing declarations for lack of standing but otherwise affirmed the final judgment setting aside the challenged DHS guidance. The First Circuit dissolved its stay on September 23. On September 24 DHS filed Supreme Court application No. 26A406 for an immediate administrative stay and a stay pending certiorari; Justice Jackson requested a response by September 28. The filing attributes canceled and disrupted flights, added expense and diplomatic engagement to the restored judgment, but those operating claims remain filed government assertions rather than independently reconciled agency records.
